# Blueroll
> Food safety management app for UK restaurants

Blueroll is a mobile app that replaces paper HACCP records with digital checklists, AI-powered recipe import, allergen tracking, and one-tap compliance reports. Built for independent UK restaurants at £14.99/month with a 14-day free trial.

## Features
- Digital HACCP checklists (daily, weekly, monthly)
- AI recipe import (photo, text, PDF)
- Allergen matrix (14 EU allergens)
- Compliance PDF reports for EHO inspections
- Team management with check-in/check-out
- Temperature logging with alerts
- Document storage with expiry reminders
- FSA rating integration

## Free Tools
- Food Hygiene Rating Badge: https://blueroll.app/free-food-hygiene-rating-badge.html

- Ratings Explained: https://blueroll.app/food-hygiene-ratings-explained.html
